author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Clip Engine library that fetches one limited list of your Twitch clip details for Random Clip Player, Clip Courier, Raid Scout, and other approved clip tools.
changelog: 4.1.8: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.8, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: initial shared cache release.

manifest.name: Clip Library Cache

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Clip Library Cache - Refresh

installationSteps: Install the Clip Engine library once when Random Clip Player, Clip Courier, Raid Scout, or another installed component declares thsv.clip-library-cache as a dependency.
Import the matching Clip Library Cache Streamer.bot package. Keep Refresh enabled but triggerless; StreamBridge runs it on a schedule using the approved action ID.
In the wizard, approve only THSV Addon - Clip Library Cache - Refresh, enable the shared clip list, save, and restart StreamBridge.
Return to the consuming add-on. Clip Library Cache has no overlay and never plays, posts, or downloads a clip by itself.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstalling keeps only a limited list of clip details. No video files or playback links are stored.

healthChecks.description: Checks that the shared clip list can be refreshed.
